summary: Customer is evaluating a spectral measurement interface for a laboratory classification study using model biological tissues (chicken muscle, fat, liver). They want to compare MIR ATR and fluorescence information, noting heterogeneity and possible sequential sampling mismatch. They request a first comparison experiment and a clear statement of what its results would demonstrate.
